text:
The issue is caused by an incorrect API endpoint. The debug logs show requests are targeting `https://ollama.com/api` (which returns an HTTP 404), whereas Ollama Cloud requires the `https://ollama.com/v1` endpoint.

### Solution

Ensure your configuration routes to the correct Ollama Cloud endpoint:
- Use the built-in `ollama-cloud` provider, which routes to `https://ollama.com/v1`.
- If you have manually defined a `base_url` in `~/.hermes/config.yaml`, update it from `https://ollama.com/api` to:
  ```yaml
  base_url: https://ollama.com/v1
  ```
